title: CloudFormation 堆疊、變更集與偏移偵測
description: 用範本建立堆疊，看建立失敗時的自動回復，用變更集預覽並套用更新，偵測有人在範本以外做的修改，最後刪除堆疊並保留重要的 bucket。

files.~/cfn/app.yaml:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Storage, alerts and logs for one environment of the app
Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, prod]
    Description: Environment name
Resources:
  AppBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub lab-app-${EnvName}-${AWS::AccountId}
  AlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub app-alerts-${EnvName}
  AppLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /app/${EnvName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Value: !Ref AppBucket
  BucketArn:
    Value: !GetAtt AppBucket.Arn
  TopicArn:
    Value: !Ref AlertsTopic
files.~/cfn/app-v2.yaml:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Storage, alerts and logs for one environment of the app
Parameters:
  EnvName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, prod]
    Description: Environment name
Resources:
  AppBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub lab-app-${EnvName}-${AWS::AccountId}
  AlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub app-alerts-${EnvName}
  AppLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /app/${EnvName}
      RetentionInDays: 90
Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Value: !Ref AppBucket
  BucketArn:
    Value: !GetAtt AppBucket.Arn
  TopicArn:
    Value: !Ref AlertsTopic

steps.instruction: 進入 ~/cfn，用 cat 看看 app.yaml 的參數、資源和輸出，用 validate-template 檢查範本，再用它建立堆疊 lab-dev（使用預設的 EnvName）。用 describe-stacks 看狀態和 Outputs。
steps.hint: cd cfn，aws cloudformation validate-template --template-body file://app.yaml，aws cloudformation create-stack --stack-name lab-dev --template-body file://app.yaml，aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name lab-dev

steps.instruction: 用同一份範本建立正式環境的堆疊 lab-prod（EnvName=prod）。它會失敗：用 describe-stack-events 找出原因（有人在導入 IaC 之前手動建立了同名的 bucket）。停在 ROLLBACK_COMPLETE 的堆疊不能更新，把它刪除。
steps.hint: aws cloudformation create-stack --stack-name lab-prod --template-body file://app.yaml --parameters ParameterKey=EnvName,ParameterValue=prod，aws cloudformation describe-stack-events --stack-name lab-prod，aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name lab-prod

steps.instruction: app-v2.yaml 把記錄的保留期限改成 90 天。為 lab-dev 建立變更集 v2，用 describe-change-set 看會修改哪個資源、需不需要取代（Replacement），確認後執行。
steps.hint: aws cloudformation create-change-set --stack-name lab-dev --change-set-name v2 --template-body file://app-v2.yaml，aws cloudformation describe-change-set --stack-name lab-dev --change-set-name v2，aws cloudformation execute-change-set --stack-name lab-dev --change-set-name v2

steps.instruction: 同事直接用指令把 /app/dev 的保留期限改成 7 天。模擬這件事，再對 lab-dev 做偏移偵測，用 describe-stack-resource-drifts 看哪個資源、哪個屬性被改了。
steps.hint: aws logs put-retention-policy --log-group-name /app/dev --retention-in-days 7，aws cloudformation detect-stack-drift --stack-name lab-dev，aws cloudformation describe-stack-resource-drifts --stack-name lab-dev

steps.instruction: 刪除堆疊 lab-dev。範本裡 AppBucket 設了 DeletionPolicy: Retain：刪除後用 aws s3 ls 看看哪些資源還在。
steps.hint: aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name lab-dev，aws s3 ls，aws sns list-topics
